story:
On 23 May 2026 Mrs. Didi Esther Walson-Jack received the African Iconic Public Service Award and was inducted into the Hall of Fame of the African Iconic Women Recognition Awards.

The same awards had named her African Iconic Female Administrator of the Year in 2024, and recognised her with the African Iconic Women Recognition Award in the same year.

A fuller account of the ceremony and the citation will be added here.

title: African Public Service Award
summary: Honoured with the African Public Service Award at the 4th African Heritage Awards in Accra, Ghana.
story:
On Saturday 11 April 2026 the African Heritage Awards honoured Mrs. Didi Esther Walson-Jack, then Head of the Civil Service of the Federation of Nigeria, with the African Public Service Award at the fourth edition of the awards in Accra, Ghana.

Other honourees at the ceremony included Abdulrahman Haske, who received the African Humanitarian Award, and Dr. Akinwumi Adesina, who received the African Lifetime Achievement Award. Reports say the organisers recognised individuals for their contributions to innovation, leadership and development across the continent.

Demonstrated the true philosophy of African resilience.

Press reports attribute this remark about the recipients to Ghana’s President John Mahama.

title: University of Lagos Distinguished Alumnus Award
venue: Eko Hotel and Suites, Victoria Island, Lagos
summary: Honoured as a distinguished alumna at the UNILAG Alumni Association’s 55th Anniversary Honours Dinner in Lagos.
story:
Mrs. Didi Esther Walson-Jack earned her Bachelor of Laws from the University of Lagos in 1986. On Friday 17 October 2025 the University of Lagos Alumni Association honoured her as a Distinguished Alumna at its 55th Anniversary Honours Dinner, held at the Eko Hotel and Suites, Victoria Island, Lagos.

Press coverage of the dinner described the honourees as among Nigeria’s most distinguished personalities, whose legacies continue to illuminate the ideals of the University of First Choice.

story:

The committee’s chairman, Hon. Dr. Bashiru Dawodu, had earlier visited the Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation as part of efforts to strengthen disability inclusion in the Nigerian public service, and publicly commended the Office’s drive for an inclusive public service.

A fuller account of the presentation will be added here.

story:
The Permanent Secretaries Service-Wide presented Mrs. Didi Esther Walson-Jack with an Award of Appreciation at the 2025 Federal Civil Service Rewards and Recognition Ceremony on 28 June 2025.

The ceremony closed the 2025 Civil Service Week, which also included the first International Civil Service Conference. The Rewards and Recognition Policy had been among the service-wide reform instruments introduced during her tenure.

story:
The Unity Schools Old Students Association (USOSA) presented Mrs. Didi Esther Walson-Jack with its Lifetime Achievement Award in October 2025.

She is an old student of two Federal Government Colleges: Federal Government Girls’ College, Benin (1976 to 1981) and Federal Government College, Ilorin (1981 to 1983). The award recognises a public career that began in the Rivers State Ministry of Justice in 1992 and led to the highest administrative office in the Federal Civil Service.
